lines.en: I call Karin and wind up getting summoned over to the park to join her for her morning jog.
lines.zh: 我给 Karin 打了电话，结果被叫去公园陪她晨跑。

lines.en: Or to join her for what would have been her morning jog if my sheer existence didn't cause everyone and everything around me to stop the moment I show up.
lines.zh: 或者说，如果不是我这张脸一出现，周围的人事物就会全部停摆，那本来该是她的晨跑。

lines.en: My presence is all it takes for Karin to stop caring about her health, and we spend the next ten years on that bench, slowly fusing with it until our blood has turned to sap.
lines.zh: 只要我在场，Karin 就不在乎什么健康了，我们在那张长椅上度过了接下来的十年，慢慢和它长在了一起，直到血液都变成了树液。

lines.en: My legs are the first to go. They're removed by maintenance workers as they were beginning to terrify children. But Karin's legs are nice, so they get to stay a little while longer.
lines.zh: 最先没的是我的腿。维修工人把它们拆走了，因为它们已经开始吓到小孩。但 Karin 的腿很好看，所以还能多留一阵子。

lines.en: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is nothing of substance occurs.
lines.zh: 总之，我想说的是，什么实质性的事都没发生。

lines.en: We just talk and waste away along with the morning sun.
lines.zh: 我们只是聊着天，和晨光一起慢慢耗掉。

lines.en: At least I can take solace in the fact she isn't broken yet.
lines.zh: 至少我还能因为她尚未被毁掉而感到一丝安慰。

lines.en: These utterly untainted moments I get to spend with someone who reminds me there is still purity in this world do not go unnoticed.
lines.zh: 和她在一起的这些全然未被玷污的时刻——她让我想起这世上还有纯粹存在——我没有视而不见。

lines.en: But noticing them alone is not enough to change anything.
lines.zh: 但光是察觉到它们，并不足以改变任何事。

lines.en: And just because I am temporarily sated does not mean I'm comfortable or happy.
lines.zh: 我只是暂时被喂饱了，并不代表我安逸或快乐。

lines.en: I still want to sleep inside her.
lines.zh: 我还是想睡进她的身体里。
